subject.title: Fix issue98298:Prune stale thinking blocks from older assistant turns in contextPruning

question: Should OpenClaw expose an operator-configurable `contextPruning.thinking` policy, or keep stale-thinking replay handling internal and provider-owned?
rationale: The supplied related work explicitly frames the provider-owned boundary as avoiding a new public replay config/default, while this PR introduces exactly that contract.

options.title: Keep provider-owned replay policy
options.body: Prefer the current canonical provider-specific replay boundary and close or replace the configuration-heavy approach after source verification.

options.title: Adopt an explicit operator control
options.body: Accept the new configuration surface only with documented upgrade semantics, sibling-provider behavior, and real replay proof.

recommendation.title: Keep provider-owned replay policy
recommendation.body: Prefer the current canonical provider-specific replay boundary and close or replace the configuration-heavy approach after source verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The related replay-policy proposal provides the strongest available ownership signal in the supplied context.
